text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: (UWAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kitasaaan! Kitasan Black-!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fans had gathered all around
the bus bound for the summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm so grateful.
To have this many fans...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't let it go to my head!
I've gotta give it my all with a hearty heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with all the praise, there was no fear
of her getting carried away. Modesty had been
drilled into her since childhood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whooosh... whooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And upon arriving at the camp lodge—
Kitasan Black stood gazing at the sea, deep in thought."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
1st place in the fan vote... 1st place, huh...
Trainer, popularity really is a mysterious thing, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Popularity is a bit different from strength or achievements...
Being strong doesn't guarantee it,
and being weak doesn't mean you won't have it...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“I don't think I'm running like someone
worthy of 1st place just yet, though!”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I know there are still greater heights to reach, so having everyone
praise me this much makes me feel... a little uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In contrast to before, she seems at a loss
over how to handle her surging popularity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Here—I ought to help change the perspective.
choice_data_list: Why not take it as "high hopes for the future"?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: High hopes for what's ahead?
choice_data_list: Yeah, like they're about to pull something off.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Looks like they're about to do something...!
Thinking of it that way, it kind of makes sense!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I'm amazing right now,
it's that people think the future me is going to be amazing!
That's what you mean, right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the advice, she seems to have
sorted out her feelings somehow.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“Still, expectations are just expectations. I haven't
brought smiles to everyone's faces yet. That's why...!”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this summer, I want to gain the strength to live up to all of my fans' expectations!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That is why—please give me
all the special training you can! Like a crashing wave,
let's go at it with a bang!
